entities.name: Tomik Vrona
entities.description: A law and security mage of Ravnica, chief advokist of the Orzhov Syndicate and former apprentice of Teysa Karlov.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Tomik's former master, who later usurped the guild leadership.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Tomik's husband, an Izzet planeswalker. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The ghostly hierarchs Kaya and Teysa planned to remove.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Guild recruited by Ral to stage an attack.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: Her corpse was brought by Tomik to Rix Maadi, where she was revived as a bloodwitch.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war after which Tomik served as acting guildmaster.

entities.name: Tomik Vrona (Echoverse)
entities.description: Echoverse version of Tomik, raised by Izzet scientists and a sparkmage.

events.summary: Tomik helps Kaya and Teysa plan to remove the Obzedat by offering Ral's help in return for Orzhov attendance at the guild summit.
events.quote: Tomik helped Kaya and Teysa in their plans to get rid of the Obzedat

events.summary: Tomik and Ral help Kaya escape when Teysa complies with the hierarchs.
events.quote: He and Ral helped Kaya escape

events.summary: Tomik brings Hekara's corpse to Rix Maadi, where she is revived as a bloodwitch.
events.quote: Tomik was the one who brought Hekara 's corpse to Rix Maadi

events.summary: Tomik finds a loophole letting Kaya transfer her guild duties to him, making him acting guildmaster; he later marries Ral.
events.quote: Tomik now the acting guildmaster, Kaya was free to planeswalk away for short periods

events.summary: While Kaya fights the Phyrexians, Teysa usurps the guild leadership; Tomik oversees day-to-day functions.

relations.quote: His apprenticeship under Teysa Karlov had helped him build a career
He is chief advokist of the Orzhov Syndicate
He and Ral helped Kaya escape
